title: Multi-subscription node benchmark
subtitle: Uses an isolated test route without changing your active proxy. Compare download, upload, latency, and reliability over time.
empty: Choose subscriptions, select nodes from the live filtered list, save, then click Run in the top-right corner.

notices.saved: Settings and competing nodes saved. The benchmark remains stopped; click Run in the top-right corner when ready.
notices.saveIncomplete: The competing-node list is not fully confirmed yet. Wait for candidate loading to finish, then save again.
notices.paused: Benchmark stopped and the current task cancelled; history was kept
notices.retestQueued: Selected nodes queued for immediate retest
notices.confirmExclude: Exclude “{{name}}” (source: {{profile}}) from the benchmark? The subscription will not be modified and you can restore it later.
notices.estimatedOverLimit: The estimate exceeds the daily limit. That direction will be deferred when the limit is reached.

settings.title: Scope and test rules
settings.stepOneHelp: Selecting subscriptions automatically shows all of their nodes. Include and exclude keywords filter the list below immediately.
settings.saveDoesNotStart: This button only saves settings and creates the node preview. Start manually in step 3.
settings.automaticPreview: Subscription changes reload nodes automatically. Keyword filtering is local and uses no benchmark traffic. Saving never starts the benchmark.
settings.enabledHelp: Turning it off stops new scheduled tasks but keeps history.
settings.profileUnavailable: This subscription is no longer available. Uncheck it and save to remove it.
settings.includeHelp: Separate with |. Both node and subscription names are matched.

candidates.title: Step 2: Filter, select, and save nodes
candidates.help: All nodes from the selected subscriptions appear here first. Keywords filter this list live; then select the final competing nodes.
candidates.scopeChanged: The subscription scope changed. Wait for nodes to reload before saving.
candidates.empty: No candidates yet. Select at least one subscription above and its nodes will appear automatically.
candidates.filterEmpty: No nodes match the current keywords. Adjust the include or exclude keywords.
candidates.pendingWhileRunning: Subscription additions or configuration changes were detected. Confirmed contestants keep running; new nodes are never tested until you preview and save again.
candidates.confirmHelp: Only selected nodes are saved as competing; unselected nodes become Excluded. Saving keeps the benchmark stopped until you click Run in the top-right corner.

control.title: Step 3: Run or stop
control.runningHelp: Long-term scheduling is enabled. It waits when no test is due and continues after this page closes.
control.pausedHelp: No new tests will be dispatched. Saved settings and ranking history are retained. Run and Stop are always in the top-right corner.
control.confirmFirst: Save the scope and confirm competing nodes first
control.saveFirst: Save the current settings and competing node list first
control.selectFirst: Select and save at least one competing node

history.title: Clear all test history?
history.warning: This permanently deletes all latency, download, upload, reliability, and ranking samples and cannot be undone. Today's used traffic and daily-limit counters also reset, so running again today may consume the traffic again.
history.preserved: Subscriptions, filters, competing nodes, and exclusion decisions are preserved. The benchmark remains stopped and the next Run starts a fresh bootstrap cycle.
history.stopFirst: Stop the benchmark in the top-right corner before clearing history
history.cleared: Cleared {{count}} historical test records. The benchmark remains stopped.

windows.help: The range only affects ranking statistics. All history means from the first test until now, not only data older than 7 days.

traffic.title: Today's test traffic
traffic.help: The estimate is a conservative upper bound through the end of today and uses actual per-run history when available. Bytes transferred before a failure are included in Actual.

task.title: Background task
task.waiting: Benchmark running · waiting for next test
task.dueNow: A test is due and waiting for the background worker
task.noScheduledNode: No confirmed testable nodes are currently scheduled
task.retryHelp: The affected direction retries automatically. See each node's latest failure in the leaderboard.

reminders.title: Latency suggestions (your confirmation required)
reminders.saving: Estimated daily saving if excluded: download {{download}}, upload {{upload}}
